About Me

A little about who I am.

🎓 Computer Science Undergraduate @ LSBU

Hey, I'm Yusha, a tech enthusiast and aspiring cybersecurity professional, currently studying B.Sc (Hons) Computer Science (Cybersecurity) at London South Bank University.

I'm driven by curiosity. I like understanding how technology really works, then turning what I learn into something I can build. From an AI healthcare concept made for an international competition to a Scratch game that won at school fests, I learn best by making things.

Alongside code, I design posters, invitations and logos, and I keep growing through AI courses from Google, Intel and Microsoft. My goal is to build secure and innovative solutions that genuinely help people.
